scripts.dev: concurrently -n emulators,web -c yellow,cyan "firebase emulators:start --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit=./emulator-data" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.dev:fresh: concurrently -n emulators,web -c yellow,cyan "firebase emulators:start" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm catalog:build && pnpm --filter @lifting/shared build && pnpm --filter @lifting/web build && pnpm --filter @lifting/functions build
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm build && firebase deploy --project staging --only hosting,functions,firestore
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm build && firebase deploy --project prod --only hosting,functions,firestore
